title: #3153 · Stop stacking sync PRs and looping base branches

slides.h: Merging a sync PR closed the wrong PR
slides.svg: <g class=""><rect class="n tr" x="105" y="30" width="150" height="46" rx="8"/><text class="nt" x="180" y="59">master</text><text class="sub" x="180" y="94">trunk</text></g><g class=""><rect class="n" x="105" y="200" width="150" height="46" rx="8"/><text class="nt" x="180" y="229">java-v9</text></g><path class="e bad" d="M105 223 C30 200 30 76 105 53" marker-end="url(#a-bad)"/><text class="el bad" x="62" y="131" style="text-anchor:start">collection PR</text><text class="el bad" x="62" y="149" style="text-anchor:start">closed as merged</text><path class="e ink" d="M255 53 C330 76 330 200 255 223" marker-end="url(#a-ink)"/><text class="el ink" x="298" y="131" style="text-anchor:end">sync PR</text>
slides.evidence: Nobody merged the collection PR. GitHub marked it merged when the sync PR landed, because Junior had stacked them.
slides.n: In sentry-docs, a weekly sync PR merges master into java-v9, while a long-lived collection PR goes the other way. When the sync merged, GitHub closed the collection PR too. Nobody had merged it.

slides.evidence: Recorded run of the PR's new test at base 4fc0a41. The test calls the branches main and feat/long-lived; they stand in for master and java-v9.
slides.n: Junior builds a stack by walking from a PR to the PR below it. Here that's a circle: seven-oh-one to seven-hundred and straight back, so the chain fills with repeats until the depth limit gives up.

slides.claim: A PR from the default branch is never stacked work.
slides.evidence: Head commit 7c74ace: the new guard at line 77 returns no stack when the PR's head is the trunk.
slides.n: With the fix, the same test stops before the walk even starts. The sync PR comes from master, the trunk, and that is never stacked work.

slides.claim: The new skips need no log line.
slides.evidence: Both new tests, run at both commits. The old stacking test also fails now if the walk steps past the trunk.
slides.n: Run the two new tests on both commits. Before the fix, both build an eleven-PR stack and fail. After it, neither builds a stack, and Junior never calls the Stacks API.

slides.claim: Stacking onto an open collection PR is fine for now.
slides.evidence: Not handled by this PR: a feature PR into java-v9 still stacks on the collection PR.
slides.n: One case stays open. A feature PR into java-v9 still stacks on the collection PR, and merging that stack as a group could land java-v9 on master early.
